access_note: Some PubMed/PMC direct pages returned challenge or minimal pages; indexed abstracts from primary publication records were used where stated. No unavailable full text is claimed as read.

sources.title: ACSM Position Stand: Resistance Training Prescription for Muscle Function, Hypertrophy, and Physical Performance in Healthy Adults: An Overview of Reviews
sources.verification_scope: official ACSM release and indexed publication summary
sources.limitations: Healthy adults; does not establish a rehabilitation protocol.

sources.title: Novel Resistance Training-Specific Rating of Perceived Exertion Scale Measuring Repetitions in Reserve
sources.limitations: Small squat study; RIR is a subjective estimate and is not a pain measure.

sources.title: RPE vs. Percentage 1RM Loading in Periodized Programs Matched for Sets and Repetitions
sources.verification_scope: publisher full-text page and indexed summary
sources.limitations: Short, small study in trained men; not a post-injury trial.

sources.title: The Effect of Load and Volume Autoregulation on Muscular Strength and Hypertrophy: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
sources.verification_scope: indexed structured abstract and publisher metadata
sources.limitations: Fifteen studies; load and volume autoregulation are distinct; average effects are not an individualized fatigue algorithm.

sources.title: Autoregulated resistance training for maximal strength enhancement: A systematic review and network meta-analysis
sources.limitations: Indirect comparisons and ranking probabilities do not establish a universally best method or clinical safety.

sources.title: The Minimum Effective Training Dose Required for 1RM Strength in Powerlifters
sources.limitations: Mixed interview/survey evidence plus small training interventions; minimum dose is not optimal dose; high effort is inappropriate to copy into injury re-entry.

sources.title: Effects of Periodization on Strength and Muscle Hypertrophy in Volume-Equated Resistance Training Programs: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
sources.limitations: Training-status subgroup uncertainty; limited long-term and elite-athlete evidence.

sources.title: Does Taking a Break Matter—Adaptations in Muscle Strength and Size Between Continuous and Periodic Resistance Training
sources.limitations: Healthy participants, controlled detraining; not a prediction for an advanced lifter after back pain.

sources.title: NICE NG59: Low back pain and sciatica in over 16s: assessment and management
sources.verification_scope: indexed official recommendations; direct page retrieval intermittently blocked
sources.limitations: General assessment/management guidance; does not prescribe barbell loads or diagnose the owner.

sources.title: Interventions for the Management of Acute and Chronic Low Back Pain: Revision 2021
sources.limitations: Interventions depend on presentation and clinical assessment; no universally curative exercise.

sources.title: NHS: Back pain
sources.limitations: Triage information only; symptom absence has not been established for the owner.

sources.title: Effect of two different weight-loss rates on body composition and strength and power-related performance in elite athletes
sources.limitations: Twenty-four mixed-sport athletes; group-average weight-loss findings are not a fixed individual target.

sources.title: A systematic review, meta-analysis and meta-regression of the effect of protein supplementation on resistance training-induced gains in muscle mass and strength in healthy adults
sources.verification_scope: indexed abstract and indexed full-text dose-response result
sources.limitations: The estimated breakpoint is uncertain; not an exact cap and not a direct prescription for energy restriction.

sources.title: Higher compared with lower dietary protein during an energy deficit combined with intense exercise promotes greater lean mass gain and fat mass loss: a randomized trial
sources.limitations: Short, intensive intervention; not advanced powerlifting rehabilitation and not support for copying a large energy deficit.

sources.title: WHO guidelines on physical activity and sedentary behaviour: at a glance
sources.limitations: Population health target; individual re-entry should be gradual and symptom-informed.

sources.title: International Olympic Committee consensus statement on acute respiratory illness in athletes part 1: acute respiratory infections
sources.verification_scope: indexed abstract and publisher return-to-sport sections
sources.limitations: Respiratory illness context; no universal number of rest days for every illness.

sources.title: A Meta-Analysis of the Effects of Foam Rolling on Performance and Recovery
sources.limitations: Mostly acute outcomes in healthy participants; does not establish prevention or treatment of disc injury.

sources.title: Exploring the Dose-Response Relationship Between Estimated Resistance Training Proximity to Failure, Strength Gain, and Muscle Hypertrophy: A Series of Meta-Regressions
sources.limitations: Exploratory estimates of RIR; associations do not define an exact universal optimum.

sources.title: A new approach to monitoring exercise training
sources.limitations: Cycling and basketball validation; session load is not tissue stress, medical readiness or injury probability.
